annotation: Beitrag zur Sammlung »The Progress of English Poetry« (INr 130152, Obj 15)
incipit_statement: Rear high thy bleak majestic hills, / Thy shelter’d valleys proudly spread / And, Scotia, pour thy thousand rills, / And wave thy heaths with blossoms red
preferred_title: On the death of ROBERT BURNS
